en: Colorized historical street view showing a gently curving city street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the wide street. A prominent corner building has striped awnings and signage including "La Rosa Habanera." At the bottom edge of the image the street name "Houtstraat" and the city name "NIJMEGEN" are printed.
